primary.title: Kyriale Solesmes 1961 – Ad Aspersionem Aquae Benedictae

pages.content: Asperges me: antiphon, Ps.50, Gloria Patri (first portion)
Asperges conclusion, rubric omit Gloria Patri Passion Sunday; omit aspersion Palm Sunday; Vidi aquam antiphon and Ps.117
Vidi aquam Gloria Patri, repeat antiphon, Eastertide Alleluia after first versicle and response; Exaudi nos conclusion

rubrics.observed: Gloria Patri omitted on first Passion Sunday, antiphon repeated directly after Psalm
In dominica II Passionis aspersio omittitur
Dominica Paschae usque ad Pentecosten inclusive
Ostende nobis: Tempore Paschali additur Alleluia; Et salutare tuum: Temp. Pasch. Alleluia

holds: Do not use these CC0 GABCs as accepted scores before printed neume-by-neume approval
Source-page identification is not evidence the local Schola chose that tune
The printed Kyriale allows other ad libitum aspersion chants; do not infer the source's first option as universal
Do not infer an actual ceremony merely because the calendar and Mass form make it eligible
